column1: # frame_ref.tsv -- the N2a text form of a frame reference (tcn_schema 0.11, #35 N2a).
# The shared contract between every implementation of the text form: the C++
# contract library (src/sqe/test/test_frame_ref.cpp) and the SQE engine's Rust
# tests both run every row of this file. Installed as
# share/tcn_schema/sqe/frame_ref.tsv. An implementation that does not pass it
#   local:<fragment>/<name>     a node in a fragment (owner = fragment)
#   domain:<domain>/<name>      a node in a domain (owner = domain)
#   each optionally followed by the selector suffix [instances].
#   <fragment> and <domain> take the fragment rule ([A-Za-z0-9_.:/-], non-empty,
#   no empty chunk); <name> takes the identifier rule ([A-Za-z0-9_.:-],
# THE PARSE, in this order; the first failure wins and names the code:
#   2. the text contains '[': it must end with "[instances]" and contain no
#      strip the suffix; selector = instances (otherwise frame)
#   3. scheme = everything before the FIRST ':'; no ':'    -> missing_scheme
#      scheme not exactly local, global or domain
#      otherwise the identifier rule on the body
#   5. local, domain: split the body at the LAST '/'; none -> missing_owner
#      the fragment rule on the owner, then the identifier rule on the name
#   The identifier and fragment rules report, in order:
#      empty; then the first byte outside the alphabet as non_ascii (>= 0x80),
#   contains_slash cannot occur here: a global body with '/' stops at step 4,
#   and the split at the last '/' leaves none in a local or domain name.
#   format() is the inverse: text -> ref -> text is exact for every ok row.
#   A LOCAL ref with an empty owner ("this fragment") exists only inside a join
#   on the wire; it has no text form.
#   UTF-8. One record per line, ending in LF; one CR directly before the LF
#   is stripped (a CRLF checkout reads the same), and nothing else is. Fields
#   are separated by exactly one TAB (0x09), no quoting, no escaping, no
#   trimming: a field is every byte between two TABs. No field contains a
#   TAB or a newline. Lines that are empty or begin with '#' are comments.
#       text parses; scope is local|global|domain, owner is "" for global,
#       selector is frame|instances; format() gives text back.
#       text is refused with this code (an empty text is an empty field).
# Codes are the stable snake_case error codes of tcn::sqe::code(Error).
# --- ok: ':' is an identifier and fragment character; the scheme ends at the FIRST ':'
# --- ok: the owner is everything before the LAST '/'
# --- ok: the whole identifier alphabet in a name, the whole fragment alphabet in an owner
# the suffix is stripped before anything else is looked at
# the alphabet is checked before the chunk structure
# the owner is checked before the name
